name: ehr-governance-packet
description: Produce the normalized JSON deliverable for an EHR quality-governance task — duplicate-merge readiness packets, specialty referral coordination packets, care-transition handoff packets, duplicate-review + ServiceRequest QA, and referral-batch audits. Use when a prompt gives clinical/governance object IDs (patients, duplicate candidates, referrals, ServiceRequests, batches) plus an `input/payloads/answer_template.json`, and asks for normalized JSON that reconciles a read-only EHR/referral environment against that template. Read this before gathering data or writing the answer.
